task: FE-59 / FE-61 / T-030 — paired Android-to-macOS screen-share runtime

android_emulator.source_revision: pre-existing installed release; exact source revision not established

session_safety.note: Android auto-joined when selecting the voice channel with its microphone initially enabled; it was muted immediately, before screen capture. No microphone recording was made.

checks.name: Voice prejoin roster parity
checks.observation: Before joining, Android and macOS showed the same active Voice-channel participant. SHARE_TEST was empty before the test.

checks.name: Mac discovery and explicit viewer open
checks.observation: macOS showed the Android participant as screen-sharing and exposed the explicit Watch screen action. The participant card did not contain a video thumbnail.

checks.name: Remote frame rendering and crop
checks.observation: The selected app was rendered on macOS as a complete portrait frame with letterboxing; the stopwatch digits changed between observations. No edge crop or black viewer was observed.

checks.name: macOS receiver diagnostics
checks.observation: Receiver counters were non-zero while frames were visibly advancing. Voice-dock RTT was 5–8 ms and was not treated as screen receiver RTT.

checks.name: Return from app-only source
checks.observation: Android displayed its explicit hidden-source message and retained the last participant-card thumbnail. macOS retained the last decoded frame while receiver counters fell to zero; it did not go black.

checks.name: Stop and cleanup
checks.observation: Stopping from Android removed the screen publication; dumpsys media_projection returned null. Both clients left SHARE_TEST and the Android roster returned to empty.

limitations: Android used an existing 1.0.25+2039 release, older than current workspace source version 1.0.28+42; current Android source has not yet been installed for this run.
The sender-side Android statistics were not sampled simultaneously, so sender/receiver counter correlation remains open.
No browser receiver, physical Pixel, or browser-published source was tested.
